mathematics.polynomial_supplier: Complete elementary coarse polynomial bound (2md+1)^k, both binary zero conventions, and ternary (4md+1)^k. Critical-system zero count proved via total-degree monomial reduction and distinct-point interpolation, without unproved Bezout or genericity.
mathematics.vc_supplier: Global-mask polynomial count proves VC<64W². Layer partition proves stronger VC<=CWL log(2W), hence the original required CL²W log W when W>=2.
mathematics.consumer_strength: No weakening of either original Yarotsky clause(ii) exponent or logarithmic exponent is required.
mathematics.sharp_warren: The sharp classical Warren bound is neither asserted nor proved; it is unnecessary for these consumers. The retained missing supplier ID names a coarser fully proved bound.
